title: Chess in Neon Garden
description: A young East Asian man in ornate blue and purple traditional robes with glowing blue patterns kneels on a colorful tiled floor, reaching to move a golden chess piece. He faces a surreal living chess set with a gnarled tree-like structure holding flowers and glowing blue orbs as pieces.
prompt: A young East Asian man with dark hair wearing intricate dark blue and purple robes with gold sash and glowing blue arcane patterns, kneeling on one knee on a vibrant pink and purple tiled floor, focused expression as he moves a golden chess piece. He faces a surreal living chess opponent made of twisted brown branches and roots sprouting large pink and purple flowers, with glowing blue spherical pieces. The background is a dreamy psychedelic garden with oversized flowers, neon geometric light structures in pink and blue, soft pastel circular wall patterns, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
